annotations.title: DMD Costs guides and case notes

description: Searches the guides and case notes DMD Costs has published on legal costs in England and Wales: detailed assessment, Part 36 offers, fixed costs, payments on account, housing disrepair, clinical negligence and MoD noise-induced hearing loss (NIHL) costs, and recent costs judgments. Returns the closest articles, best first, each with its summary, key points, the dates it was published and last reviewed, and its link. Use it for background reading or the case law on a costs point, and cite the article's link; for a short answer to a costs question, a glossary term or a court form, use search_legal_costs_help.

limit.description: How many articles to return, best match first: a whole number from 1 to 10 (default 5).

query.description: What to look for, in plain words: a costs topic, rule or case, e.g. 'payment on account percentage', 'Part 36 offer with non-money terms', 'housing disrepair costs-only proceedings' or 'Cubic v TfL'.
